item.title: 雙轉輔？來看看出國交換吧！

item.title: U.S. Master's Applications in Actuarial Science
item.description: Five U.S. actuarial master’s programs, four admissions. My profile, the documents each school asked for, how I tailored one core story across them, and the timeline.
